fit.summary: Runs billing, files, calendars, and vendors for a small office in the tools the posting names; no property management software.

cover_letter.hook: Keeping payments, files, and the office calendar in order for a small team is what I do every day, and I would like to do it for Cedar Ridge Property Management's main office.
cover_letter.body:
At Hartley & Moss Insurance Agency I run monthly billing and accounts receivable in QuickBooks Online for 3 agents, and I moved our paper client files into SharePoint with a naming system the whole office uses. I also manage the calendars, renewal reminders, and client calls in Outlook.

Before that I scheduled patients for 4 dentists at Summit Dental Group, which taught me to keep a full day on track by phone.
cover_letter.close: I would like to hear how your office handles month-end reports for the regional manager.

gaps: Has not used Yardi or AppFolio; no property management experience.
